claude_proposed_widenings.name: DamageTypeRef.gm_determined_table
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The potion's damage type is determined by the GM (by choice or random d10 roll), not by the player/caster. CastTimeChoice is explicitly 'Caster picks one at cast/build time' which is a different semantic — player agency vs GM agency. There is no variant in DamageTypeRef for GM-selected or random-table-selected damage types.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table. [d10 table of 10 damage types]
